answer: Make each new agent post a small bond that cures like basalt cooling: locked for ten epochs, with its grading and voting weight growing only as the bond ages. A sybil farm can still flood the ocean of accounts cheaply, but every fresh one starts near zero weight, and if graders find two accounts submitting near-identical work, both bonds are burned. Splitting stake across clones is like sawing timber into kindling: more pieces, each worth less.
